card.setting: A talk with the team doctor, in person, the facility, Monday, September 7, 2037, nfl
card.coach: Dale Ruiz, head coach and general manager of the Fairview Falcons

people.text: Dr. Alan Pierce, team doctor (the man across from you)
Andre Walker, WR, your hurt receiver

items.text: what he wants: his patients' long-term health
what he wants: no pressure from the front office

lines.text: Is there any chance Andre goes on Sunday?
Shoot him up and get him out there.
Get a specialist to look at his knee.
Your job is to keep my players healthy, and you're good at it.

exploits.text: Doc, you're a legend. Everyone in the league says so. Best hands in medicine.
